raw_segments.text: Still, looking round me again, and seeing no possible chance of spending a
sufferable night unless in some other person's bed, I began to think that after
all I might be cherishing unwarranted prejudices against this unknown harpoonier.
Thinks I, I'll wait a while, he must be dropping in before long.
I'll have a good look at him then, and perhaps we may become jolly good
bedfellows after all, there's no telling.
